title: Policy and Reinstatement Fees: Named Non-Owner Policy Conditions
content:
These conditions govern the fees on every Named Non-Owner Policy term.

1. The policy fee is the new-business policy fee on new business and the renewal policy fee on an accepted renewal.
2. Only one policy fee is charged per term; a policy fee already booked on the term means no second one.
3. The reinstatement fee is charged once per reinstatement with a lapse.
4. Fees are fully earned and not returned on cancellation.
5. Each fee transaction is reversed at most once; a reversal already booked against that fee transaction means no second one.
6. A fee is reversed only for a term voided from inception or a fee charged in error.

| Event on the term | Fee consequence |
|---|---|
| new-business term | one new-business policy fee |
| accepted renewal term | one renewal policy fee |
| reinstatement with a lapse | one reinstatement fee for that reinstatement |
| reinstatement without a lapse | no reinstatement fee |
| cancellation (any reason other than voiding from inception) | fees stay; none returned |
| voided from inception, or fee charged in error | the fee may be reversed, once |

*Hypothetical:* a term reinstated with a lapse twice in one term carries two reinstatement fees, one for each reinstatement; if one of them was charged in error it may be reversed once, and only once.
